scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run cap -- sync
scripts.mobile:android:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=${ANDROID_JAVA_HOME:-${JAVA_HOME:-/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-amazon-corretto}} ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:android:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=${ANDROID_JAVA_HOME:-${JAVA_HOME:-/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-amazon-corretto}} ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.play:internal: cd android && bundle exec fastlane internal
